name: QASC
description: Question Answering via Sentence Composition (QASC) is a multi-hop question answering benchmark requiring retrieval and composition of two facts from a large corpus to answer 8-way multiple-choice science questions. Each question requires combining two sentences from a 17M sentence corpus to derive the answer.
reputation: Science QA benchmark requiring multi-hop fact composition; tests retrieval and reasoning over large corpora; human performance ~93%
notes: Introduced at AAAI 2020. Contains 9,980 8-way multiple-choice science questions (8,134 train, 926 dev, 920 test). Each question is annotated with two supporting facts from a 17M sentence corpus. The key challenge is identifying and composing the correct pair of facts. Tests multi-hop retrieval and reasoning in science domain.
